name: manual_d58116
claim: Cline CLI 'task' subcommand, qualified by version: 'cline task <prompt>' existed on the Cline CLI of about July 2026 (the original autoresearcher fallback and early skills used it; exact version U), but there is NO task subcommand on CLI 3.0.49 (verified 2026-08-05) or 3.0.74 (verified 2026-11-10): it exits with 'Unknown command or unquoted prompt'. LIVE form on >= 3.0.49: prompt is a bare positional argument ('cline -P cline-pass -m <slug> --json -t 120 "multi word prompt"'); one-word prompts are rejected as mistyped subcommands. Older instructions stay as history; live code must use the positional form. scripts/cline_autoresearcher.py kept the old form from 2026-07-01 until the 2026-11-10 fix (local branch 2026-11-10-002-cline-cli-positional-prompt, commit 46b81aa3, unpushed).
conditions: cline task subcommand positional prompt 3.0.74 3.0.49 version

decisions.notes: Repo records (clinepass-deepseek-flash skill, July lessons) plus live runs on 3.0.74 showing the usage error and the positional form passing.

rationale: Repo records (clinepass-deepseek-flash skill, July lessons) plus live runs on 3.0.74 showing the usage error and the positional form passing.
